title: Gaussian affinity times score mismatch is uniformly O(N) in a fixed relative profile band

uniform_pair_control.hypothesis: Translated stationary diagonal Gaussian components have c_- S_N^*<=S_i,S_j<=c_+ S_N^* for fixed positive c_-,c_+; means are arbitrary.
uniform_pair_control.score_split: The exact K1606 polynomial is the covariance sum 2 omega_k(s_i-s_j)^2/[s_i s_j(s_i+s_j)] plus the mean sum 4 omega_k Delta_k^2/(s_i+s_j)^2.
uniform_pair_control.mean_identity: In the common diagonal basis B_ij h_ij+b_ij=2(S_i+S_j)^(-1)(m_i-m_j).
uniform_pair_control.comparison: Compact relative-band equivalence gives P_ij<=C_(c_-,c_+) Lambda_N X_ij, Lambda_N=max_k omega_k/s_(N,k)^*=O_g(N).
uniform_pair_control.uniform_bound: BC_ij P_ij<=C Lambda_N X_ij exp(-X_ij)<=C Lambda_N/e=O_g(N), uniformly without centeredness, separation, a mean bound, or a lower bound on X_ij.
uniform_pair_control.scope_guard: The theorem is for translated stationary diagonal Gaussian components in one fixed relative band. It does not control non-Gaussian components, phases, textures, nonstationarity, or arbitrary covariance eigenvectors.
